tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, the paper. Also the gap colour behind sticky day headers and the header bar.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers (popover, select list, dialog, toast, reaction tray) and the inside of text fields. Always paired with a border-strong hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Code blocks, inline code, Kbd faces, avatar fallbacks, disabled primary buttons.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on buttons, toggles and option rows; the keyboard-highlighted row in Select and the command palette.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, post prose, labels. Reads on bg, bg-raised, bg-subtle, bg-hover and accent-soft in both themes (13:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: excerpts, meta lines, dates, helper text, placeholders, Kbd glyphs. 4.5:1 or more on bg, bg-raised, bg-subtle and bg-hover in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines that only separate: between feed items, code-block edges, tab lists, tag chips at rest. Decorative (about 1.2:1), so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that identify a control or a floating layer: inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes, toggle groups, popovers, dialogs, toasts, day-header rules. 3:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one colour. Only for links, focus rings, the primary button fill and selected states. As text it reads on bg, bg-raised, bg-hover and accent-soft (6.4:1 or more).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected backgrounds: pressed toggle, your own reaction, the active tag filter, text selection. Always with accent text or an accent edge.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icons on an accent fill (primary button, checked checkbox). Dark in the dark theme because the accent lightens there.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. An alias of accent; always underlined in prose because accent alone is only about 2:1 against text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px outline, 2px off the element. 6.4:1 or more on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings as text and as a field or toast edge, always with a word that says what is wrong. 4.8:1 or more on bg, bg-raised and bg-subtle.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors as text and as an invalid field's edge, always with a message. 5.8:1 or more on bg, bg-raised and bg-subtle.

tokens.name: tooltip-bg
tokens.usage: Tooltip fill: the theme inverted.

tokens.name: tooltip-text
tokens.usage: Tooltip label, on tooltip-bg.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and the command palette.

fallbacks.usage: Arial resized to Inter 4's average width and line metrics. Text shows in it until Inter arrives (font-display: swap), so lines wrap at almost the same places and the page barely moves when Inter swaps in.

families.sans: Inter, "Inter Fallback", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Noto Color Emoji"
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Inter
groups.note: UI and reading. Line heights sit on the 4px grid.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: satisfies doesn't widen the type in TypeScript
styles.usage: The post title on a post page, and topic, tag or author page titles. One per page.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: You can rename a property when destructuring
styles.usage: Feed item titles and dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Why does it work like this?
styles.usage: Subheadings inside a post; section headings on a page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: When rice soaks in salted water for a few hours, the grains don't stick together as they cook.
styles.usage: Post prose. The reading voice of the site.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Nobody has written today yet. Be the first?
styles.usage: Feed excerpts, dialog and popover text, empty states, toast titles.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, toggles, field labels, menu items.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Text typed into fields. 16px so phones do not zoom on focus.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: We read every note before it goes live.
styles.usage: Helper and error text under fields, author names in meta lines, tooltips.

groups.name: JetBrains Mono
groups.note: Code, dates, counts, tags and key hints. Ligatures off.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks. Inline code uses the same face at 0.875em of the text around it.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, reading time, reaction counts, tag chips, language labels.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The site name in the header. Always lowercase, always hyphenated.

type.fontsNote: Google Fonts variable files (Inter with opsz + wght, JetBrains Mono with wght), roman and italic, subset to Latin + Azerbaijani letters, as woff2. Licences: fonts/*-ofl.txt.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Every gap, padding and offset is one of these.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; label to field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips and pills; padding inside compact rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field padding; between a title and its meta line; row gap of chip lists so 40px hit areas never overlap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones; button padding; popover padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs in a post; above and below a feed item.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; around code blocks; between form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Before a subheading inside a post.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between day groups in the feed; step-list number column.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a post and its reactions block; page top padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Before the footer; between major page regions on wide screens.

radius.note: One radius for almost everything; round only for people and reactions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Kbd, inline code, checkbox boxes, option rows inside lists, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, tag chips, code blocks, popovers, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, reaction pills and the reaction tray.

tokens.name: column-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the reading column, for every page.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of the column on phones and up.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Height of the sticky site header.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, fields, select triggers, toggles and option rows.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area for anything tappable; smaller visuals extend their hit area to this.

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: Visible height of a tag chip (hit area still 40px).

tokens.name: pill-h
tokens.usage: Visible height of a reaction pill (hit area still 40px).

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatar inside feed meta lines.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Avatar in post bylines and the header's signed-in button.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Avatar at the top of an author page.

stroke.note: 1px hairlines everywhere; focus is the only thicker line.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Width of the focus outline.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus outline (inset by -2px where a scroll container would clip it).

transition.note: Short fades only: no slides, scales or spins. Under prefers-reduced-motion they drop to 1ms.

tokens.name: fade-duration
tokens.usage: Every opacity fade and colour change: overlays opening and closing, hover backgrounds.

tokens.name: fade-easing
tokens.usage: Easing for every fade.

tokens.name: layer-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky site header and day headers.

tokens.name: layer-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, select lists, tooltips, the reaction tray.

tokens.name: layer-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the command palette and their scrim.

tokens.name: layer-toast
tokens.usage: Toast region, above everything.
